data.heading: About Maren Fine Jewellery
data.body:
Maren is a goldsmith's workshop in Antwerp's diamond quarter. Every stone is chosen in person and every setting is made by hand at our bench.

We use recycled gold and platinum, and every diamond comes with its certificate.

image.alt: A jeweller sketching designs at the bench

data.heading: Our story
data.body:
Maren is a goldsmith's workshop in Antwerp's diamond quarter. Every stone is chosen in person and every setting is made by hand at our bench.

We use recycled gold and platinum, and every diamond comes with its certificate.

items.q: Can I have a piece engraved?
items.a: Yes. Most rings and pendants can be engraved with up to 20 characters. Add a note at checkout.

items.q: How do I find my ring size?
items.a: Visit the studio to be measured, or ask us for a free ring sizer by post.

items.q: How should I care for my jewellery?
items.a: Store pieces separately, take them off before swimming, and clean with a soft cloth. We clean and check claws for free.

data.heading: Contact us
data.intro: Questions about an order or a product? Get in touch.

paymentMethods.label: Pay on delivery
paymentMethods.instructions: Pay the courier when your order arrives.

paymentMethods.label: Bank transfer
paymentMethods.instructions: After placing your order you'll receive our bank details. Your order is confirmed once payment arrives.

fulfillment.label: Collect in store
fulfillment.details: Collect from our shop during opening hours.

store.checkoutNote: You will receive a confirmation page with your order number. We'll contact you to confirm delivery.
store.returnsPolicy: Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 14 days of delivery for an exchange or refund. Contact us with your order number to arrange a return.
store.shippingPolicy: We deliver in 1–3 working days. Delivery fees are shown at checkout. You can also collect your order from our shop free of charge.
store.privacyNote: We use your name, phone number, email and address only to process and deliver your order and to contact you about it. We do not sell your information.
